title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
summary: Itaú is implementing its AI First strategy through ia.i, a conversational interface for customers, and the IARA governance platform, applying generative AI to both customers and employees in Brazil's highly regulated banking sector.
highlights: Itaú uses ia.i conversational interface for customer-facing generative AI
IARA governance platform supports AI deployment
AI First strategy spans customers and employees
Operates in one of Brazil's most regulated sectors
